Ever posted something just for one person?

On echoes you can leave a voice echo for specific people only, at the place that means something to the two of you. Everyone else walks past. They hear it when they get there.

Who would you leave one for? Just their initial in the comments.

caption_versions.specificity:
What does it cost to leave your voice here?

Nothing. On echoes, leaving an echo, listening, commenting and messaging are free.

The one thing that's counted: Reflections, short AR videos (up to 10 seconds) that play in full only at their spot. Everyone gets 3 free in any 30 days; extra credits are optional, in-app.

Where would you spend your 3? One place in the comments.
